cards.description: She holds a Master’s Degree in Education and a Bachelor’s in Chemistry, with over 20 years of experience in education and leadership. She is Principal of Sharjah American International School Abu Dhabi (SAIS Abu Dhabi), where she led the school’s ADEK rating improvement from “Acceptable” to “Very Good.” She is committed to innovation, inclusion, and continuous school improvement.
cards.subtitle: School Principal
cards.title: Ms. Ban Al Duri

cards.description: With fifteen years of experience across UK, Australian, Canadian, and IB curricula  and the past twelve in senior leadership Mr. Rumball bring a distinctive blend of academic rigor and pedagogical expertise, holding a BA in Criminology and a Master’s in Teaching. Mr Rumball’s practice is grounded in the conviction that personalized learning, data-driven initiatives, and strong relationships are the keys to student success
cards.subtitle: Vice Principal
cards.title: MR. Tylor Rumball

cards.description: With over 22 years of experience in education and leadership, she holds a Master’s degree in Educational Leadership and Management and has extensive expertise in school improvement, curriculum development, safeguarding, and strategic leadership. She is committed to creating safe, inclusive learning environments that promote academic excellence and support the UAE’s vision for educational success.
cards.subtitle: Job Title?
cards.title: MS. DJAMILLA

cards.description: With over 25 years of experience in mathematics education and more than 8 years in school leadership in the UAE, she brings extensive expertise in teaching, educational leadership, and curriculum development. Holding a Ph.D. in Applied Mathematics, a Master’s in Applied Mathematics and Educational Leadership, and an MOE School Leadership License, she is committed to inspiring excellence, fostering innovation, and empowering students and educators to achieve their full potential.
